mapper.update: UPDATE student SET student_number = #{studentNumber}, student_name = #{studentName}, gender = #{gender}, major_id = #{majorId}, nationality_code = #{nationalityCode}, student_category = #{studentCategory}, enrollment_source = #{enrollmentSource}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, degree_level = #{degreeLevel}, grade_year = #{gradeYear} WHERE id = #{studentId}
UPDATE app_user SET username = #{username}, display_name = #{displayName}, account_status = #{accountStatus}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, user_type = #{userType} WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE floor FROM dormitory_floor floor LEFT JOIN room current_room ON current_room.floor_id = floor.id WHERE floor.id = #{floorId} AND current_room.id IS NULL
DELETE building FROM dormitory_building building LEFT JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id = building.id WHERE building.id = #{buildingId} AND floor.id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET room_type = #{roomType}, capacity = #{capacity}, gender_restriction = #{genderRestriction}, resident_scope = #{residentScope}, operational_status = #{operationalStatus}, remark = #{remark}, state_version = state_version + 1 WHERE id = #{roomId}
